summary: Nicola Mining filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 9, 2026 news release disclosing results of an independent underground inspection by McElhanney Ltd. at its Treasure Mountain Silver Mine near Hope, British Columbia. The July 27, 2026 assessment found both portals accessible, workings largely open and ventilation functioning after roughly 13 years of inactivity, supporting an intention to reopen in 2027. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor mandate, or transaction terms were stated; this is an operational update, not a special situation. Watch for a restart decision, permitting, and financing requirements.
